threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the 243 bus is reliable. Only locals know it’s a suggestion, not a timetable.
Last night on the 59, a guy started singing opera between stops. The whole bus just went quiet, then joined in for the chorus. Classic Brixton vibes.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I heard three different languages yelling at the BVG for being late, I knew Neukölln was home. Only here can chaos sound so harmonious.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a currywurst at 3 AM while watching a street artist turn the U-Bahn station into a gallery. Pure Berlin vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who’s local by how they navigate BART mishaps. Tourists panic, locals just roll their eyes and pull up the next bus arrival time.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy juggling on the bus while a couple near the back argued about rent. Classic SF, where chaos and talent ride together.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can stroll into any bar and get 'tapas'. In Gràcia, it’s all about the platillos—tiny dishes more local folks opt for, and they’re often hidden away.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new by how they linger at the flower stalls, fumbling with their Catalan. Only locals know to save their euros for the markets.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still refer to 'the tube' as if it's your only transport option. Everyone here knows the best bus routes and the hidden bike lanes.
Sat behind two guys on the 35 who argued about the best chicken shops until one got off and yelled a 'Brixton's got the spice!' on his way out.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a guy in a suit arguing with a street musician about the best jazz record—only in Neukölln do you get that blend of chaos and culture.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you witness a techno party starting at noon on a Tuesday, with people rolling in with snacks and their kids in tow.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who’s local by how they navigate the BART delays without missing a beat. Tourists are just lost in confusion while we know the back routes.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy hop on the 21 with a parrot on his shoulder. Muni didn’t bat an eye—just another day in the ‘Loin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think 'tapas' means shared plates, but locals often prefer a quiet sit-down for a proper meal, not a snack parade.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still ask for 'tapas' instead of 'pinchos' at the bar. It's a dead giveaway in Gràcia.
